lines.en: Yusuf, look at this room. It’s going to be painted next week, and the old floor is going to be replaced too.
lines.pt: Yusuf, olhe este quarto. Ele vai ser pintado na semana que vem, e o piso velho também vai ser trocado.

lines.en: Finally! The damp patch on the ceiling has been getting worse every month. Will the workers fix that first, or paint right over it?
lines.pt: Finalmente! A mancha de umidade no teto vem piorando a cada mês. Os operários vão consertar isso primeiro, ou pintar por cima?

lines.en: They’ll treat it first, of course. The contractor gave me a quote yesterday, and it includes new insulation. Honestly, it’s cheaper than I feared.
lines.pt: Vão tratar primeiro, claro. O empreiteiro me deu um orçamento ontem, e inclui isolamento novo. Sinceramente, é mais barato do que eu temia.

lines.en: That’s a relief. What about the furniture? Is it going to be moved out first, or are the painters going to do it?
lines.pt: Que alívio. E os móveis? Eles vão ser tirados primeiro, ou os pintores é que vão fazer isso?

lines.en: The sofa and the shelves are going to be stored in the garage, so they won’t get dirty. I already cleared a corner.
lines.pt: O sofá e as prateleiras vão ser guardados na garagem, para não sujar. Já liberei um canto.

lines.en: Good thinking. And the windows? I heard the new ones will be installed on Wednesday, but nobody told me what time.
lines.pt: Boa ideia. E as janelas? Soube que as novas serão instaladas na quarta, mas ninguém me disse a hora.

lines.en: Probably early morning. They said they’d arrive around eight, so we should be out of the way by then. I’ll make coffee for the crew.
lines.pt: Provavelmente de manhã cedo. Disseram que chegariam por volta das oito, então devemos sair do caminho até lá. Vou fazer café para a equipe.

lines.en: Nice. Do they charge extra if they have to come back?
lines.pt: Legal. Eles cobram a mais se tiverem que voltar?

lines.en: No, the quote is fixed. As long as we don’t change our minds halfway through, there won’t be any surprises.
lines.pt: Não, o orçamento é fechado. Contanto que a gente não mude de ideia no meio do caminho, não haverá surpresas.

lines.en: Perfect. Then I’d like to choose the color tonight. I’m thinking pale green for the walls, with white shelves.
lines.pt: Perfeito. Então gostaria de escolher a cor hoje à noite. Estou pensando em verde-claro para as paredes, com prateleiras brancas.

lines.en: Love it. Bring the samples after dinner, and we’ll hold them up to the window to see how they look in daylight.
lines.pt: Adorei. Traga as amostras depois do jantar, e vamos segurá-las junto à janela para ver como ficam à luz do dia.

facts.big: is / are going to be + particípio
facts.label: Passivo com going to
facts.sub: Use para planos e obras. Afirmativa: is going to be done. Negativa: isn’t going to be done. Pergunta: Is it going to be done? Plural: are going to be done.

facts.label: Passivo de planos
facts.sub: Use is / are going to be + particípio para planos e reformas: The room is going to be painted. A estrutura equivale a “vai ser pintado”. Use is com singular e are com plural.

facts.label: Is / Are + sujeito + going to be
facts.sub: Na pergunta, is ou are vai antes do sujeito: Is the floor going to be replaced? Are the windows going to be changed? Respostas curtas: Yes, it is. No, they aren’t.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “It is going to be painted” is a plan.
We say “The windows is going to be changed”.
items.why: Plural: are going to be changed.

items.s: The passive keeps be after going to.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “It is going to be painted” is a plan. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “The windows is going to be changed”. → Falso (Plural: are going to be changed.)
The passive keeps be after going to. → Verdadeiro (going to be + participle.)

pages.title: Plans for a new room · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a warm Saturday in a quiet suburb of Perth. Frank opens the door of an empty room. The walls are grey. His friend Lia comes in with a coffee. A builder has given them a quote this week. They talk about the plans for the room.

“Lia, look at this room. It is going to be painted next week, and the floor is going to be replaced too.” says Frank. “Finally! Is the furniture going to be moved out first, or are the painters going to do it?” says Lia. “The sofa and the shelves are going to be stored in the garage, so they will not get dirty.” says Frank.
